title: Gateway Arch
visualBrief: Weighted catenary shell with equilateral triangular sections, separate steel faces, longitudinal shop welds, field station welds, 32 recessed observation ports and crown service hatch. Entirely editable metric geometry with a shared brushed-stainless surface.

nativeAxes.front: +X points north-northeast along the leg axis, about17°east of north; +Z points east-southeast; ports face the east-southeast and west-northwest sides
nativeAxes.origin: Ground-level midpoint between the two leg centroids

scaleBasis: NPS published centroid equation and section dimensions. Surface reconstruction yields 192.024 m height and approximately 192.025 m width without independent scaling. Ground plane clips the sloped foot sections.

geographicProposal.evidence: Fresh attributed OSM API map retrieved2026-10-10 contains exactQ2027162 node4004558403 and named Gateway Arch relation12813920/outerway951594314. Four ground outer-foot corners 8808017978,8808017979,8808017966,8808017965 were rigidly fit to the NPS equation without scaling: anchor[-90.1849746,38.624611275],heading1.262928261877rad,maximum residual1.015m. Native+X points17.640°east of north; native+Z points east-southeast. The former due-north assumption is corrected. Relation park-QID discrepancy is explicit, not treated as exact identity. Current NPS exterior photograph and retained primary HSR pages34/70/90/91 were actually inspected. Ground0 is the steel-foot upper plaza datum; lower exit courts are separate site structures. Approximate3m/2° registration, not a survey.
geographicProposal.limitations: Complete static medium-fi exterior of the Gateway Arch itself: NPS weighted catenary, equilateral triangular taper, both ground-clipped steel feet, three outer faces,32 recessed observation ports and low crown service hatch. The unchanged50314triangle detailed source master remains reproducible. Skyline is a complete128-segment catenary with triangular faces; district retains all32 actual port holes/reveals and street adds simplified shop and field welds; closeup retains the full detailed geometry. Weld station locations, port station offsets and service-hatch sizes remain photographic reconstructions. NPS fact-sheet27inch port width and HSR approximate24inch clear width differ and remain explicitly recorded. The two below-grade leg exit courts, visitor/museum building, underground interior, ramps and wider landscaped park are separate site architecture outside this steel-arch asset. GroundY0 is the upper steel-foot contact datum, not the lower exit court. Four mapped outer-foot corners constrain a rigid rotation/translation with no scaling; maximum residual below3m and2° heading tolerance acknowledge map generalization. OSM relation12813920 incorrectly carries the park Q45234; identity uses exactQ2027162 node4004558403, supported by the named steel-arch relation and observed feet. Common brushed-stainless graph approximates finish; local oil-canning, staining and individual weld condition are not duplicated. Absolute site elevation, live host terrain and physical phone/laptop timings remain unmeasured.
